titulo: Transaction approval with very low quorum
buscar_em: approval, transaction, acquisition, investment, meeting, quorum, voting
regra_spectra: Acquisition transaction (main investment) must have investor approval: (1) qualified quorum 75-80% to approve; (2) veto possibility by anchor investor if any; (3) right to not participate (without dilution) if disagreeing; (4) detailed business plan and valuation presented 30 days in advance.
como_corrigir: Establish: 'Main Investment requires: (i) approval by 75% of investors in meeting; (ii) presentation of business plan, valuation and terms 30 days before; (iii) investors who voted against may opt not to contribute their pro-rata share (without dilution).'

titulo: Capital calls without limitation or deadline
buscar_em: capital call, drawdown, contribution, funding, investment
regra_spectra: Capital calls must have: (1) minimum advance notice of 10-15 business days; (2) maximum 3-4 calls per year (except emergencies); (3) interest and fine for delay; (4) default consequences (dilution, guarantee enforcement); (5) prohibition of calls to cover portfolio company operational losses.
como_corrigir: Define: 'Capital Calls: (i) 15 business days notice before; (ii) maximum 4 per year; (iii) default: 1% p.m. interest + 2% fine + dilution after 30 days or guarantee enforcement. Prohibited calls to cover operational losses (only investments, fund expenses).'

titulo: Portfolio company governance without investor protection
buscar_em: governance, board, administration, veto, approval, portfolio company
regra_spectra: Portfolio company governance must have: (1) board majority appointed by fund; (2) reserved matters (mandatory fund approval): mergers, relevant debt, related party transactions, asset sales, change of corporate purpose; (3) unrestricted information rights; (4) right to replace portfolio company managers.
como_corrigir: Establish: 'Fund shall have: (i) portfolio company Board majority; (ii) veto over: mergers, debt >R$ X, related transactions >R$ Y, asset sales >10% equity, purpose change; (iii) unrestricted information access; (iv) right to replace CEO/CFO with 75% board approval.'

buscar_em: liquidity, exit, IPO, sale, trade sale, put, call
regra_spectra: Exit strategy must provide: (1) target deadline for divestment (5-7 years); (2) mechanisms: IPO, strategic sale, secondary sale; (3) put to remaining partner after deadline; (4) right to force sale (100% drag-along) if reasonable offer; (5) 100% tag-along; (6) liquidity priority to fund.
como_corrigir: Define: 'Target exit: 7 years. Mechanisms: (i) IPO; (ii) strategic sale. After 7 years: Fund has put to remaining partner at fair value (independent valuation). Fund may force sale (100% drag) if offer >1.2x investment + hurdle. 100% tag-along. Waterfall: Fund has 1x capital + hurdle priority.'

buscar_em: partners, founders, management, founders shares, sweat equity, vesting
regra_spectra: Operating partners/management participation must have: (1) 3-4 year vesting; (2) 1-year cliff; (3) good leaver/bad leaver with repurchase; (4) economic subordination (fund receives preference); (5) no fund dilution in future rounds (full anti-dilution); (6) performance milestones for earn-in.
como_corrigir: Establish: 'Management: (i) 15% of capital; (ii) 4-year vesting, 1-year cliff; (iii) bad leaver: repurchase at cost; good leaver: independent valuation; (iv) subordination: Fund receives 1x capital + 10% IRR first; (v) Fund full anti-dilution; (vi) earn-in: 10% upfront, 5% if achieves year 3 EBITDA.'

buscar_em: expenses, costs, transaction costs, broken deal, advisory, due diligence
regra_spectra: Fund expenses must have: (1) annual budget approved by investors; (2) transaction expenses (due diligence, legal, advisory) limited to 3-5% of value; (3) broken deal costs shared; (4) prohibition of double-dipping (manager charging fee AND advisory fees); (5) full transparency (quarterly cost report).
como_corrigir: Define: 'Expenses: (i) annual budget approved in meeting; (ii) transaction expenses <5% of investment; (iii) broken deals: shared among all investors pro-rata; (iv) prohibited manager charging advisory fees beyond management fee; (v) detailed quarterly cost report.'

regra_spectra: Minority investors must have: (1) 100% tag-along in any sale; (2) drag-along exercisable by fund if offer >1.2x initial investment; (3) right of first refusal in sales between investors; (4) post-IPO lock-up applicable to all equally; (5) prohibition of transfers to competitors without approval.
como_corrigir: Establish: '100% tag-along for investors. Drag-along: Fund may force sale if offer ≥1.2x investment + 8% IRR. Right of first refusal: investors have 30 days in secondary sales. Post-IPO lock-up: 180 days for all. Sale to competitors prohibited without 75% approval.'
